notes: Island layout (start on shore, height 1): Spire is 1E 9N of start, a height-4 hilltop; path north via grass/hillside climbs 1 level per step, easy to walk. Spire is just a hilltop cell, nothing special happens on it. Cubes: cube-5 about 5N of start, cube-3 near Spire (west), cube-10 about 5E of Spire, more cubes (1,2,4,6,9) further east. Also a ring (SE of Spire) and a rock (NE) untried. Cubes stack when placed. No task given. Don't waste steps resting; try the ring and rock, throw objects, or stack cubes into a tower on the Spire.

Path: from start go N ~9 steps (hillside climbs 1/step) then 1E to Spire (height 4, nothing special). Cubes stack with 'place here'; tower of 2 on Spire made but walking away leaves it. Throw hard moves object 4 cells, stacks on target cell. Cube-10 is 4E of Spire. Ring is ~4E 3S of Spire, rock ~4E 2N: still UNTRIED - go pick them up and try place/throw them, and look at cubes further east (1,2,4,6,7,9). Do not rest; I wasted last 16 steps resting. Plan: go directly to ring (~14 steps), pick it, experiment.

Ring route: from start go N ~9 to Spire (1E), ring is 1E 3S of cube-10 (which is 4E of Spire); ~20 steps to pick. Ring: pick, place here, throw soft (lands in place, same cell), throw hard (also landed here when thrown from grass; first hard throw went 4E). Nothing special happened. Resting is useless; I wasted steps 32-60 resting. Untried: rock (4E 2N of Spire), cubes 1,2,7,9 (east, near ring's east spot), stacking cubes, throwing from a height, throw N/S/W, look. Try throwing cubes onto Spire stack. Never rest.

Episode 4 result: 3 cubes on Spire (3, 10, 1). Route: move N x8 from start to hilltop, pick cube-3 (8 N of start, 1W of Spire), place on Spire at step 11. Spire cell is 1E of hilltop. Cube-10 is 4E of Spire; throwing W from grass lands in place (blocked by higher ground), so carry it and place. Cubes 1,9 ~5E of Spire; cube-4, cube-6 further east; cube-5 on path (5N of start). Placing from adjacent cell works. Carrying cycle is ~10 steps per cube. NEVER rest: I wasted steps 35-60 resting. Next: grab cube-5 on the way north, then cubes 9, 4, 6, 8.
